dish: 'Tōge no age-imo' — the original Nakayama Pass fried potato skewer
n: Michi-no-eki Bōyō Nakayama, Nakayama Pass (道の駅 望羊中山)
address: Nakayama Pass (Route 230), Kimobetsu, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
w: The pass-top stop where Sapporo drivers first see Mt Yōtei — famous for battered, fried Danshaku potatoes from the Yōtei foothills, plus Nakayama chicken and Rusutsu-pork butadon.

dish: Niseko farm-stand produce, house ham and ice cream
n: Michi-no-eki Niseko View Plaza (道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ)
w: Niseko's roadside farm market — local vegetables and fruit straight from the growers, handmade ham and ice cream, with Yōtei and Annupuri views.

dish: village-milk and local-rice gelato, fresh-baked bread
n: Michi-no-eki Akaigawa (道の駅 あかいがわ)
address: Maple Kaidō, Akaigawa, Yoichi District, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A newer roadside station on the Maple Kaidō between Kiroro and Niseko — bread baked on site from local ingredients, Akaigawa milk, and gelato made with the village's rice.
